card.name: Word right after an instruction verb
card.fires_on: The word just after a sentence-opening instruction verb such as Administer, Use, Avoid, Coadminister or let. It is often the start of a drug name or a small word like the, only, on or as.

modes.label: Start of drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name right after Administer or Use.

modes.label: Small word after verb
modes.description: A small linking word such as the, as, on or only right after the instruction verb or drug name.
modes.example: Avoid<< the>> use of diflunisal tablets

card.plain: It fires on the word right after a dosing instruction verb like Administer, Use or Avoid, often where a drug name or a small linking word comes next.
